name: Websocket Swing / Allegro PoC
purpose: A proof of concept for entering/selecting person and payment-recipient data, synchronizing records between a browser mock UI and Swing through WebSockets, and posting form data to an HTTP echo endpoint.
key_functionalities: Swing form captures name, birth date, gender, address, payment details, and notes.
Vue client filters a static sample of people and their associated payment entries.
Node.js WebSocket relay broadcasts browser messages to all connected clients.
Alternate Swing WebSocket client maps received record data into its fields.
Primary Swing MVP posts field values as JSON to localhost:8080/post and displays the response.
OpenAPI document and Cucumber scenarios describe and exercise POST /post behavior.

technical_stack.desktop: Java 22 target, Swing, Java WebSocket API/Tyrus, JSON-P
technical_stack.relay: Node.js and websocket npm module, port 1337

architecture_patterns: MVP-like separation in the com.poc desktop path: PocView, PocPresenter, PocModel.
Observer/event-emitter callback for submission response notification.
WebSocket hub-and-broadcast messaging for browser-to-desktop data transfer.
business_domains: Bank account recipient and effective date
personas: Operator entering or submitting person/payment details in a desktop form.
Browser user searching the mock person catalog, choosing a person and payment recipient, and sending the selection to connected peers.
constraints_and_gaps: Vue search operates against hard-coded demonstration records and does not query a backend.
No application-side validation, authorization, persistence, or WebSocket message validation is apparent in the inspected paths.
Swing model serializes all declared fields and may fail on null values.
Cucumber scenarios define expected echo behavior, not evidence of durable storage.
Project includes two Swing entry paths: the MVP HTTP-posting client and a separate WebSocket receiving client.

configuration.rootMaven: pom.xml targets Java 22 and includes WebSocket/Tyrus and JSON-P dependencies.
configuration.vue: node-vue-client/package.json configures Vue 2.6 and Vue CLI 4.
configuration.modernizationTemplate: config/modernization-config.json retains generic placeholder values; target technology text includes Java 21+ and Spring Boot 3.x, distinct from current root build.
